newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-INJURED FRANK DE BOER OUT UNTIL JANUARY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INJURED FRANK DE BOER OUT UNTIL JANUARY.

text.p: Ajax Amsterdam's international defender Frank de Boer will be out of the game until the New Year after damaging his left ankle in training on Tuesday.

De Boer, Ajax's stand-in captain for the injured Danny Blind, will miss the club's two remaining European Champions' Cup league group A matches -- at home to Auxerre tonight and away to Grasshopper Zurich on December 4 -- as well as the Netherlands World Cup qualifier in Belgium on December 14.
The 26-year-old, one of only three Ajax ever-presents this season, is one of the key elements of the Ajax machine, marshalling the defence and prompting many of the side's attacking moves.
It is the latest setback for Ajax coach Louis van Gaal, who is already without Blind, Jari Litmanen, Kiki Musampa, Peter Hoekstra, Richard Witschge and a number of other walking wounded.
Ahead of the Auxerre game, Van Gaal had some good news -- that both Winston Bogarde and Arnold Scholten should be fit enough to start after recent injuries.
Van Gaal is expected to deploy Mario Melchiot to play alongside Bogarde at the heart of the defence against the French title-holders.
